title: Nine-month all-oral DR-TB
dek: The 2022 9-month BDQ-FQ-CFZ-Z-E-Hh-Eto/Lzd construct, plus 2025 modified 9-month BLMZ / BLLfxCZ / BDLLfxZ. FQ-S is the usual gate. Longer regimens remain the salvage net.
story: WHO still suggests a 9-month all-oral regimen rather than >18-month treatment for FQ-susceptible MDR/RR-TB: BDQ for 6 months plus Lfx/Mfx, CFZ, Z, E, high-dose INH, and ethionamide (or 2 months of LZD 600 mg instead of Eto), then a 5-month continuation without BDQ/Eto/LZD as specified. Pregnancy: prefer the LZD-not-Eto variant; ethionamide is a teratogenicity problem.

2025 adds modified 9-month regimens from endTB/BEAT-TB: BLMZ (BDQ+LZD+MXF+PZA) preferred among them, then BLLfxCZ, then BDLLfxZ, all for FQ-S disease versus longer regimens. WHO suggests against 9-month DCLLfxZ or DCMZ.
These are not preferred over BPaLM when BPaLM is eligible. They are the second row: FQ-S, Pa ineligible or BPaLM unavailable, still wanting <18 months. If FQ-R, do not force a FQ-S 9-month recipe.
deep: High-dose INH in the 2022 9-month hopes the strain is inhA-promoter low-level, not katG S315T. If katG S315T is present, Hh is theatre. Read the gene.
PZA only counts if pncA says so. A 9-month that leans on Z with a wrecked pncA is miscounted.
QTc: BDQ+CFZ+FQ+ (sometimes DLM) is an ECG schedule, not a surprise.
Longer individualised regimens (18–20 months, Group A/B/C) remain correct when short regimens are ineligible: extensive resistance, CNS disease needing a different construct, or failures.

visual.caption: WHO 2025 DR-TB duration ladder for FQ-S disease. Prefer 6-month BPaLM when eligible; 9-month orals next; >18-month last.

example.title: katG S315T on a 9-month with Hh
example.setup: FQ-S RR-TB, Pa unavailable, started 2022 9-month including high-dose INH. WGS: katG S315T, inhA WT, pncA WT, gyrA WT.

steps.title: Hh is inactive
steps.body: S315T is high-level INH-R. Counting Hh as an “effective drug” is a paper victory.

steps.title: Other companions may still be intact
steps.body: FQ-S, pncA WT: Mfx/Lfx and Z can still count. Rebuild the effective-drug tally.

steps.title: Consider BLMZ or BDLLfxC if eligible
steps.body: A 9-month that was leaning on Hh should be redesigned, not pep-talked.

example.takeaway: High-dose INH is allele-specific, not a 9-month mascot.

check.why: FQ-R belongs in BPaL/BDLC territory, not FQ-counting 9-month constructs.

check.why: Eto is the pregnancy problem; LZD substitution is the designed patch.
